findings.summary: The seal-verified Implement verification record reports successful exit codes for the four frozen commands but preserves neither cwd nor stdout/stderr, and it contains no independent live PumpDown alert-state query; therefore the Frozen Acceptance evidence required by the spec is incomplete.

The scheduler only prints per-tick JSON observations to stdout; the product contains no monitoring-series producer or PumpDown integration that derives series from enabled roster entries, removes disappeared labels within one scrape interval, or makes a stopped enabled unit alert while a healthy unit remains quiet.
